Release notes

Sourced from trufflesecurity/trufflehog's releases.

v3.95.9

What's Changed

  • feat: add OpenRouter detector by @​McPatate in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4500
  • Integrations fully codeowns detectors by @​trufflesteeeve in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5104
  • [INS-332] Add New Relic Insights Insert key detector by @​mustansir14 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4778
  • [INS-351] Added Duffel Token Detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4795
  • [INS-341] Added Shippo detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4820

  • [INT-650] Don't log as error when git diff is too long by @​bill-rich in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5113

New Contributors

  • @​McPatate made their first contribution in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4500
  • @​eightseventhreethree made their first contribution in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4965

Full Changelog: https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/compare/v3.95.8...v3.95.9

  • d328285 [INS-410] Added batch token detector (#4824)

  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
